dedupe_keys.name: scada data set of the edp onshore wind farm in portugal filtered release

description: This data set is a filtered, documented release of SCADA data from an onshore wind farm operated by Energias de Portugal (EDP), which EDP first published on its open data platform. It was prepared by Krzysztof Kijanowski, Tomasz Barszcz, Wieslaw Staszewski and Phong Dao to give researchers a clean, described version, with the filtering explained in a paper in Energies (2025). It covers four turbines (T01, T06, T07 and T11) for 2016 and 2017 at 10-minute intervals in UTC. Contents are SCADA signals per turbine with 83 columns, such as generator, gearbox and hydraulic oil temperatures, rotor speed, wind speed and direction, pitch angles, active and reactive power and grid voltage, current and frequency, each in two versions filtered at 95 and 99.9 percent confidence; meteorological mast data with 41 columns; about 256,000 event log entries; and 28 confirmed component failures of gearbox, generator, transformer and hydraulic group. Coverage is one site. Files are 10 Excel files, about 174 MB, downloadable from Mendeley Data (2026) under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. Caveats: the event log reset column is almost empty and the site name is not given. Simulation uses are fault detection, failure prediction and condition monitoring. Related records: data-la-haute-borne-wind-farm-scada and data-care-to-compare-wind-turbine-scada-anomalies, which also builds on EDP data.
